ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the figure is a cyclohexene-like six-membered ring fragment, and on the right side of the ring there is a vertical double bond; above it is connected to a negatively charged oxygen atom, and below it is connected to an R group. On the right side is an enone/carbonyl fragment, where one C=C, one C-C connected to the carbonyl carbon, one C=O, and the alkyl C-C connected to the right side of the carbonyl carbon can be seen. There are also multiple curved arrows in the figure, but the problem asks to ignore the arrows. Then reason: count according to the left and right parts and do not count any hydrogen-containing bonds. The left six-membered ring has 6 C-C ring connections; adding 1 C-O bond connected to the negatively charged oxygen and 1 C-R bond connected to the R group, the left side has a total of 8 non-hydrogen bonds. The right fragment has 1 C=C connection, 1 C-C bond from the alkene carbon to the carbonyl carbon, 1 C=O connection, and 1 C-C bond from the carbonyl carbon to the right alkyl group, so the right side has a total of 4. The total number is 8 + 4 = 12.

method.method_draft: First scan the image and separate the structure into the left ring fragment and the right enone/carbonyl fragment. For the left fragment, count the six C-C connections around the cyclohexene ring, then add the C-O bond to the negatively charged oxygen and the C-R bond, giving 8 non-hydrogen bonds. For the right fragment, count the C=C connection, the C-C bond from the alkene to the carbonyl carbon, the C=O connection, and the C-C bond from the carbonyl carbon to the right alkyl group, giving 4 more. Add 8 + 4 = 12.

method.method_draft: Build the non-hydrogen connectivity graph from the drawing. The six-membered ring contributes 6 adjacency edges because a closed six-membered ring has six side connections, even though one side is drawn as a double bond. The substituents on the ring add two more graph edges: upper ring carbon to O and lower ring carbon to R. The separate right-hand molecule has four heavy-atom adjacencies: terminal alkene carbon to internal alkene carbon, internal alkene carbon to carbonyl carbon, carbonyl carbon to O, and carbonyl carbon to the right carbon group. The graph therefore has 6 + 2 + 4 = 12 edges/bonds.

推理：按非氢原子之间的连接边来数键。左侧六元环本身有 6 条环边，其中双键所在边也按一条连接计数。环上的两个取代连接分别是环碳-O 和环碳-R，共 2 条。右侧分子有 4 条重原子连接：端基烯碳-内部烯碳、内部烯碳-羰基碳、羰基碳-O、羰基碳-右侧碳基团。因此总数为 6 + 2 + 4 = 12。
